description: Day-by-day steps over a range, one row per day as Garmin returns it: calendarDate, totalSteps, totalDistance (metres) and stepGoal. get_daily_summaries has the same steps alongside floors, calories, HR and stress; for weekly or monthly averages over longer spans use summarize_wellness. Up to 92 days per call: pass a period (e.g. last_7_days, last_30_days, this_month) or start_date/end_date.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to start_date. Max span 92 days.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Required unless period is given.

name: get_steps
title: Steps
